unlisted_practices: Integrating EHR-informed patient profile context and a clinical knowledge graph reasoner into multimodal activity recognition to improve accuracy
Benchmarking on a public dataset (VAST) to check reproducibility beyond private clinical data

screen.reason: Evaluates a multimodal LLM framework (ClinActNet) for patient activity monitoring deployed in hospital environments, measuring accuracy and reduction in overlooked critical incidents, but does not test a specific organizational safeguard or deployment practice.
